energy_definition: Compare association of Pa with two hosts. Binary: E(Tb.Pa) - E(Tb) - E(Pa). Ion-pair-containing case: E(C8IL.Tb.Pa) - E(C8IL.Tb) - E(Pa), where C8IL.Tb retains the complete cation, anion and Tb as one reference group. The latter is not the total assembly energy from four isolated molecules. Use the same electronic-structure level throughout; state whether reference fragments are relaxed or frozen and whether counterpoise/BSSE or other corrections are applied.
reference_definition_boundary: Molecular identity and reference grouping are defined here; a unique author conformer, BSSE treatment and solvent/control convention are not supplied. An independently computed isolated-gas control must not be called an exact reproduction of an external numerical control until its model correspondence is established.
units: Report interaction energies in kJ/mol and retain raw energies in the native program unit.
